summary.vi: Chủ điểm này dạy cách diễn tả sự nhượng bộ (concession) bằng although/even though + mệnh đề, despite/in spite of + danh từ hoặc V-ing, và however như một connector nối hai câu độc lập.
summary.en: This point teaches how to express concession with although/even though + clause, despite/in spite of + noun or V-ing, and however as a connector between two independent sentences.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn muốn nói một sự việc xảy ra bất chấp một trở ngại hoặc điều trái ngược.
when_to_use.en: When you want to say something happens in spite of an obstacle or a contrasting fact.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn muốn đưa ra một nhượng bộ ngắn gọn bằng cụm danh từ hoặc V-ing thay vì cả một mệnh đề.
when_to_use.en: When you want to make a short concession with a noun phrase or V-ing instead of a full clause.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn muốn nối hai câu độc lập có ý trái ngược trong văn viết trang trọng hơn.
when_to_use.en: When you want to link two independent sentences with a contrasting idea in more formal writing.

examples.text: Although he was tired, he kept working.

annotation.vi: Although mở đầu mệnh đề nhượng bộ; mệnh đề chính nêu kết quả trái ngược.
annotation.en: Although introduces the concessive clause; the main clause gives the contrasting result.

translation.vi: Dù mệt, anh ấy vẫn tiếp tục làm việc.
translation.en: Although he was tired, he kept working.

examples.text: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.

annotation.vi: Despite + cụm danh từ (the traffic), không theo mệnh đề.
annotation.en: Despite + noun phrase (the traffic), not a clause.

translation.vi: Dù tắc đường, chúng tôi vẫn đến đúng giờ.
translation.en: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.

examples.text: The task was difficult. However, we finished it.

annotation.vi: However nối hai câu độc lập, thường đứng sau dấu chấm và trước dấu phẩy.
annotation.en: However links two independent sentences, usually after a full stop and before a comma.

translation.vi: Nhiệm vụ khó. Tuy nhiên, chúng tôi đã hoàn thành nó.
translation.en: The task was difficult. However, we finished it.

reason.vi: Despite không đi với mệnh đề đầy đủ (finite clause); cần Although + mệnh đề hoặc Despite + cụm danh từ/V-ing.
reason.en: Despite cannot be followed by a finite clause; use Although + clause or Despite + noun/V-ing.

common_mistakes.wrong: Despite he was tired, he continued.
common_mistakes.right: Although he was tired, he continued.

explain.vi: Despite + cụm danh từ (the rain). Although cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ.
explain.en: Despite + noun phrase (the rain). Although needs a full clause.

explain.vi: However nối hai câu độc lập; Although cần mệnh đề phụ ngay sau nó.
explain.en: However links two independent sentences; Although needs a subordinate clause right after it.

quick_practice.q: ___ she was ill, she went to class.

explain.vi: Although + mệnh đề (she was ill). Despite không đi với mệnh đề đầy đủ.
explain.en: Although + clause (she was ill). Despite cannot take a full clause.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu về bản thân dùng 'Although' + mệnh đề để nêu một trở ngại và kết quả trái ngược.
prompt.en: Write a sentence about yourself using 'Although' + clause to give an obstacle and a contrasting result.

sample.text: Although I was tired, I finished my homework.

corrections.issue: R5's example 'In spite of feeling ill, she went to class.' is correct but the lesson did not include a formula or spans for the target structures.
corrections.fix: Added a formula with abstract slots for although/even though + clause and a separate example for despite + noun; spans now mark the connector, subject, and verb roles.

corrections.issue: R5's mistake 'It was late, however we stayed.' was listed but the correction 'It was late. However, we stayed.' was not clearly explained as a punctuation rule.
corrections.fix: Kept the mistake but added a clear reason: however cannot join two independent clauses with only a comma; it needs a full stop or semicolon.

corrections.issue: R5 did not include a quick-practice section or personal production card.
corrections.fix: Added three cloze questions and a personal production card with a pattern rule that checks for the connector, subject, and verb.
